olean = D:\lean\.lake\build\lib\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1795StrictFiberFunctorActual.olean (226280 bytes, SHA256 6638F60ADC30DD1DB275DDF92896F86C849B47FDF05D023AFAFBB0899D4DF9D7)
axioms = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] only; no sorry/axiom/native_decide (grep + #print axioms).

RESULT: two of the three named oblIGATIONS ARE PROVED, the third is reduced exactly.

1) S1795RawIdentityObligation : S1764RawIdentityObligation  -- PROVED.
   The raw fiber map of S1641CoverMapId is STRICTLY equal to id (not just the nat-iso of S1764).
   General form: geometricFiberMap_id_strict (any F, X, base scheme, base point).

2) S1795RawCompositionObligation : S1764RawCompositionObligation -- PROVED.
   S1764RawFiberMap (S1641CoverMapComp f g) = S1764RawFiberMap g ∘ S1764RawFiberMap f, strictly.
   General form: geometricFiberMap_comp_strict.
   Proof: expand S1641CoverMapComp_commutes_hom_app to  associator > (f.map < g.commutes) > f.commutes,
   kill the functor associator and both functor unitors (all componentwise identities),
   use Cat.whiskerLeft_app to turn the whiskered component into g.commutes.app (f.map.app site . obj x.left),
   then associativity/id-comp.

3) S1764FiberMapWellDefinedObligation -- NOT PROVED and NOT provable from the S1728 data; exact first missing identified:
   * S1795RawFiberFunctor_obj_left (rfl): left component of the raw image is literally
     (f.map.app site).toFunctor.obj x.left, i.e. the OBJECT map of the underlying 1-morphism.
   * S1795WellDefined_forces_strict_objmap (PROVED): well-definedness forces the STRICT equality
     (f.map.app site).toFunctor.obj x.left = (g.map.app site).toFunctor.obj x.left.
   * S1795FiberMapWellDefined_iff (PROVED):
       S1764FiberMapWellDefinedObligation
         <-> S1795StrictObjectMapAgreement  (strict agreement of the underlying object maps)
           / S1795StrictHomAgreement       (agreement of the commuting 2-cell/comparison components).
   Why this is a genuine gap: S1728CoverMapRel f g = Nonempty (f.map = g.map) is a 2-iso of strong
   transformations; at each site it gives only an ISOMORPHISM of the functors f.map.app site and g.map.app site,
   not equality of their object maps, and it forgets the commutes 2-cell entirely. So no 2-iso cancellation
   inside the S1728 quotient can produce the strict function equality. The exact missing input is a
   strictification (a choice of strict representatives / equality of the raw images). I did NOT fake it and
   did NOT assert it. (A formal *refutation* would need a concrete counterexample cover pair; that is not
   constructed here, so the statement is recorded as an open strictification input, not as refuted.)

4) Consequences also in the file:
   * S1795ConcreteFiberFunctorMissing_iff:
       S1764ConcreteFiberFunctorMissing <-> S1764FiberFiniteObligation / S1764FiberMapWellDefinedObligation.
     So of S1764's four missing items only (a) geometric finiteness (S1735) and (b) strictification remain.
   * S1795StrictFiberDataNonempty_iff: Nonempty S1764StrictFiberData <-> finiteness / well-definedness.
   * S1795FiberFunctorOfRemaining (hF) (hW) : cover category (S1728 Category.{1,1}) to FintypeCat.{0},
     with obj = actual geometric fiber (S1795FiberFunctorOfRemaining_obj). Builds on S1764FiberFunctorOfObligations.

Technical note (no statement change): the file sets  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
because the CostructuredArrow objects live in Cat (Cat.Hom / Cat.Hom2 wrappers) and the unitor/associator
component computations otherwise fail the instances-transparency check. Statements are unchanged.

Not done / suggested next: (i) finiteness of the actual fiber (S1735 track); (ii) a strictification of the
S1728 2-iso quotient (e.g. a section of the quotient map with strict functoriality, or an equivalent strict
model) to discharge S1795StrictObjectMapAgreement + S1795StrictHomAgreement; (iii) optionally a concrete
counterexample pair of 2-isomorphic but non-strictly-equal cover maps, which would turn the informal gap
argument into a formal no-go.

I did not edit coord/STATE.md, coord/queue.md or AUDIT_LEDGER.md (shared files, left to you).
